footer.tagline: Fassarar mafarki da AI, kyauta — bisa gargajiyar Ibn Sirin da zamani tsarin tunani (psychology).

home.heroLede: Tsoffin alamomi, zamani ilimin halayyar dan'adam, da AI — hada cikin karatu daya mai haske. Bayyana mafarkinka da kalmominka, ka sami fassarar da ta tsaya a kan Ibn Sirin da zurfin ilimin halayyar dan'adam.

interpret.title: Bayyana mafarkinka
interpret.placeholder: Jiya da yamma na yi mafarkin cewa ina wuce ta kofa da take canza siffarta koyaushe...
